summary: A React + Tailwind single-page "Private Valentine's Website for Priyy🦋" featuring an animated love-letter message carousel with romantic styling (floating hearts, shimmer/heartbeat animations, themed typography), plus scaffolding for Internet Identity authentication and ICP canister actor creation via React Query. Add an interactive final-slide "Will you be my valentine?" prompt with Yes/No behavior and follow-up messages. The backend canister currently contains no methods (empty actor).

existing_features.title: Valentine's message carousel UI
existing_features.description: Renders a four-part romantic message experience with titles/text, 'Previous'/'Next' navigation, and clickable pagination dots, including an initial fade/slide-in entrance transition.

existing_features.title: Layered romantic background visuals
existing_features.description: Applies multiple full-screen background layers: two generated image overlays (bokeh + hearts) with opacity and a gradient wash using romantic Tailwind color tokens.

existing_features.title: Floating hearts and accent animations
existing_features.description: Creates an ambient floating hearts effect (15 heart icons with randomized positions/durations) and uses custom animations (heartbeat, shimmer, bounce) plus a butterfly accent image at the bottom.

existing_features.title: Romantic Tailwind theme and custom CSS animations
existing_features.description: Defines a romantic OKLCH-based color palette and typography tokens via CSS variables, extends Tailwind colors/fonts/radii, and provides custom keyframe animations (float-heart, heartbeat, shimmer, fade-in, slide-up, bounce-slow). Imports Google Fonts (Great Vibes, Playfair Display, Lato).

existing_features.title: React Query client setup
existing_features.description: Initializes and mounts a QueryClientProvider at the app root to support query caching and async resource management across the application.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Implements an InternetIdentityProvider using @dfinity/auth-client that initializes an AuthClient, loads any stored session, supports login with configurable derivation origin and a 30-day max TTL, supports logout/clear, and exposes status flags and errors via a React Context hook (useInternetIdentity).

existing_features.title: Authenticated/anonymous ICP canister actor hook
existing_features.description: Provides a useActor hook that creates and caches a backend actor (backendInterface) either anonymously (no identity) or authenticated (agentOptions.identity), keyed by principal in React Query with infinite staleness; on actor availability, it invalidates and refetches all non-actor queries to ensure downstream queries use the latest identity-bound actor.

existing_features.title: Update the final carousel slide in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (the message with title "Will You Be My Valentine?") to render two CTA buttons: "Yes" and "No".
Implement the "Yes" button behavior: when clicked, replace the question content on the final slide with a thank-you, loving message that includes the exact phrase "you are forever mine".

Implement the "No" button behavior: when clicked, display a message stating there is no choice to select no, and then re-display only the "Yes" option (do not continue to show the "No" button after it is clicked).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add Yes/No buttons on the final 'Will you be my valentine?' slide: Yes shows a thank-you loving message (including 'you are forever mine'); No shows a message that there is no choice to select no and re-displays Yes.

architecturalNotes: Frontend built with React function components and hooks; main UI is a single App component rendered via ReactDOM.createRoot.
State management uses local component state for UI (message index, intro transition) and React Context for authentication state.
Authentication integrates DFINITY Internet Identity via @dfinity/auth-client, wrapped in an InternetIdentityProvider context with explicit login/logout actions and status flags.
Data/actor lifecycle is managed with @tanstack/react-query: a QueryClientProvider at the root, and a useActor hook that caches an authenticated/anonymous backend actor keyed by principal.

Tailwind CSS design system uses CSS variables (OKLCH tokens) to define a romantic palette, supports dark mode via the 'class' strategy, and extends Tailwind with typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
Custom CSS animations (float-heart, heartbeat, shimmer, fade/slide/bounce) are implemented in a Tailwind utilities layer and consumed via utility class names.
ICP canister integration pattern: createActorWithConfig() is used to construct an anonymous or identity-bound actor (backendInterface) depending on authentication.
knownIssues: Backend canister (backend/main.mo) is an empty actor with no exposed functionality; frontend actor scaffolding cannot call meaningful backend methods yet.

Two different index.css contents appear in the provided file list (duplicate 'frontend/index.css' vs 'frontend/src/index.css'); this suggests potential file duplication/confusion about which stylesheet is actually used (main.tsx imports './index.css' from src).
Floating hearts use Math.random() during render, so any re-render will reposition and change animation timing of all hearts (visual jitter).
useActor invalidates and refetches all non-actor queries whenever the actor instance becomes available; this can cause unnecessary network/refetch churn in larger apps.
DEFAULT_IDENTITY_PROVIDER is sourced from process.env.II_URL; if not configured, login may fail without a clear configuration-time validation.
